verdict.rationale: Tailscale's KB documents the exit-node feature as routing all internet traffic through a specific device on your network, which matches the story directly. A community user independently confirms using an exit node at home to get past a geoblock while abroad. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of setup (advertising and approving exit nodes, per-platform client support, LAN access options); the evidence is only a one-line KB summary.
